lede: The biggest thing on the civic calendar this week is Monday's Town Council meeting, where a deed-restriction amendment for two units at 215 East Colorado Avenue — converting them from capped affordable ownership units to employee dwelling units — goes to a public hearing on second reading, a structural change to how those homes function in Telluride's housing stock. The Telluride Housing Authority takes up the same question a day earlier, on Monday the 22nd, along with a separate policy item. Norwood's Planning and Zoning Commission also meets Sunday to review and potentially adopt Phase I of a full Land Use Code rewrite — the kind of change that sets development rules for years to come.

notable.stake: Norwood could formally adopt Phase I Land Use Code changes governing density and development.
Resolution to convert two affordable ownership units, removing their maximum sale price cap.
Public hearing on deed-restriction conversion that removes price cap from two town housing units.
